key_insight: BTTF rethinks chip verification by turning raw simulation data into a queryable database and using multi-agent LLM orchestration to answer waveform/debugging questions automatically.
engineering_relevance: It targets a major gap in EDA workflows beyond RTL generation, making post-simulation verification more scalable and less manual for complex SoC design teams.
method: Normalizes large simulation dumps into a relational SQLite database.
Uses collaborative agents to translate natural-language verification requests into schema-aware SQL.
Correlates detected signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories for debugging context.
evidence_signal: On a 150-query benchmark, BTTF achieved 95.33% execution accuracy.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful schema design and robust handling of diverse simulation formats and RTL versioning conventions.
paper_title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
